name: Tinfield 1
notes: Agentic/terminal fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (model card base_model), same qwen4exp architecture: 48 blocks, 12 full-attention and 36 linear-attention (gated delta net) layers, 512 experts with 10 active, plus the n-gram/engram embedding table. params_b 176.9 is the parameter count llama-server reports for the GGUF build (n_params 176,943,899,520, identical to the base). active_params_b 6.6 is the figure from the model card, not derived here; the base model's registry entry derives 4.7, so treat the bandwidth bound computed from either as approximate. context_length 262144 is n_ctx_train from the GGUF and the 256k on the card. The Hugging Face card lists pipeline_tag image-text-to-text like the base; the GGUF build ships no mmproj projector, so llama.cpp serves it text-only. released is the creation date of the Hugging Face repo.
